:::{#exm-quantifier}
#### Quantified propositions

Let $P(x)$ be the predicate "$x > 2$", for [integers](number-systems.qmd#def-integers) $x$.

- "$\exists x \in \cb{1, 2, 3}, P(x)$" is true, because $P(3)$ is true.
- "$\forall x \in \cb{1, 2, 3}, P(x)$" is false, because $P(1)$ is false.
- "$\forall x \in \cb{3, 4, 5}, P(x)$" is true,
  because $3 > 2$, $4 > 2$, and $5 > 2$ are all true.

:::
